title: RoleMesh eval dataset row
description: One JSONL line of a rolemesh-eval dataset. Datasets are homogeneous: every row has scoring.state_check, or none do (split mixed task types into separate files). Associate this schema with *.jsonl eval datasets in your editor for autocomplete and inline validation; the loader (src/rolemesh/evaluation/dataset.py) is the authority and enforces additional cross-row rules.

id.description: Unique sample id within the dataset.

input.description: Prompt for the agent. May contain {{trial_id}}, which the runner replaces with the per-trial isolation key — required whenever a probe references {{trial_id}}, so the agent knows which entity to operate on.

target.description: Judge rubric(s): what a correct final reply looks like. One string or a list; each entry is judged independently by Inspect's model_graded_qa (answer_check scorer) and the score is the fraction of rubrics satisfied — pass^k reducers only count a trial that satisfies all of them.

state_check.description: Environment-state acceptance criteria, verified host-side against the staging backend after the trial. GET-only.

url.description: HTTP GET target. May contain {{trial_id}} and ${ENV_VAR} references.

headers.description: Request headers. Values must reference secrets as ${ENV_VAR} — literal credentials are rejected by the loader (datasets are git content).

expect_status.description: Expected HTTP status. Counts as one graded check; a mismatched status that arrives is evidence (graded fail), not infrastructure failure.

assert.description: Checks against the JSON response body. All are evaluated (no short-circuit); the sample's state_check score is the fraction passed.

path.description: Dotted path into the response body; integer segments index lists (e.g. items.0.status).

op.description: equals: ==; contains: substring or list membership; exists/absent: path presence (no value); gte: numeric >=; matches: regex search on a string.

value.description: Expected value. Required for all ops except exists/absent. String values may contain {{trial_id}}. gte needs a number, matches needs a regex string.

metadata.description: Free-form annotations — tags for slicing analysis, provenance of the task (which production failure it came from), difficulty. Never graded; flows into the .eval log.
